about.title: A studio that ships products
about.subtitle: Northline exists to build digital products that grow businesses — not to decorate decks.
about.whyBody: Too many companies get either design or engineering. They need one partner speaking both languages. That is why Northline exists.
about.howBody: Remote-first, weekly demos, written decisions. A small, disciplined team on the same side as the client.
about.approachBody: Business problem first, interface second, code third. Motion and 3D only when they clarify the product.
about.qualityBody: Accessibility, performance, and maintainability are part of delivery — not afterthought polish.

stages.purpose: We study users, competitors, and product context — making risks and opportunities visible.
